description: UFO mini-story part 1/4: the wait, the night drive, the beam in the forest, and a figure descending in the light. Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-ufoarc1/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-ufoarc1.mp4): eleven pieces (0.6 s padding each) of the stream #5 hour files in output order (windah-live5/stream-2216-2316.mp4 = h4, stream-1916-2016.mp4 = h1), 1080p30 re-encoded and joined. Cuts: T t 1685.20-1686.40 = local 0.60-1.80 -> output 0.00-1.20; A t 328.30-332.20 = local 3.00-6.90 -> output 1.20-5.10; B t 1032.90-1037.00 = local 8.10-12.20 -> output 5.10-9.20; C t 1521.25-1524.25 = local 13.40-16.40 -> output 9.20-12.20; D t 1527.52-1530.12 = local 17.60-20.20 -> output 12.20-14.80; E t 1561.00-1566.00 = local 21.40-26.40 -> output 14.80-19.80; F t 1613.80-1619.90 = local 27.60-33.70 -> output 19.80-25.90; G t 1645.45-1647.60 = local 34.90-37.05 -> output 25.90-28.05; H t 1665.00-1675.00 = local 38.25-48.25 -> output 28.05-38.05; I t 1681.40-1685.00 = local 49.45-53.05 -> output 38.05-41.65; J t 1716.00-1722.05 = local 54.25-60.30 -> output 41.65-47.70. Beats in stream order: frame-0 teaser (h4 28:05, the glowing disc in photo mode, 1.2 s), then the running gag (h1 5:28 'misteri UFO di akhiran, kita misi-misi dulu lah'; chat spams UFO from VOD 2:04), h4 17:13 Google says UFO only at night, h4 25:21 '12 AM, ideal buat ketemu misteri UFO' and 'go now', label MALAM INI over the night drive (h4 26:01), the dark forest road 'ada orang di luar sana?' (26:54), 'ke tengah hutan, ada apa ini?' (27:25), the glow, the beam and the phone camera (27:45-27:55), the photo-mode zoom (28:01-28:05), and the cliffhanger: a figure descends in the beam and Windah says 'itu kenapa ada ibu-ibu gemoy?' (28:36-28:42). Word timings from short-window faster-whisper medium with VAD. CUT: h4 26:20 'what the f...' and 26:41 'anjir' (outside the cuts), 27:39-27:42 'hell no', 28:08.3-28:09.4 'what the f' (swear), the in-game subtitle 'Lucia: What... the fuck?' (28:41-28:45; it sits below source y846, which the face layout crops away, and the cut ends at 28:42.05 before the voice line); 27:25.4 first word is 'anjing/anjir?' by medium (cut starts after it; check by ear). No guns, gore, drugs, bra top or shirtless Jason in these frames. Main 47.70 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1504x846 at (0,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 440x330 at (1480,538) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'PART 1 · UFO DI GTA VI', line 2 Volt 'CHAT NAGIH UFO 3 JAM', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
